PORT.description: HTTP listen port. Must match the EXPOSE and Railway domain port.

INTELLIGENCE_API_URL.description: CopilotKit Intelligence platform API (durable threads, memory, history).

INTELLIGENCE_GATEWAY_WS_URL.description: CopilotKit Intelligence realtime gateway (WebSocket) for live agent events.

INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY.description: CopilotKit Intelligence project runtime key (cpk-...). Create one at https://intelligence.copilotkit.ai (API Keys) or via the CopilotKit CLI.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI (or any OpenAI-compatible gateway) API key that the built-in bots use. Replace with a real key.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Empty = call OpenAI directly. Set to point at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM).

BOT_MODEL.description: Optional. Override the built-in bots' model. Empty = provider defaults (gpt-5.5 / claude-sonnet-4-5 / gemini-2.5-flash).

MANAGED_AGENT_AG_UI_URL.description: Optional. Endpoint of an external AG-UI harness (LangGraph / Mastra / CrewAI) to mount alongside the built-in bots.

MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token the external AG-UI harness presents when this server calls tools back. Only needed with MANAGED_AGENT_AG_UI_URL.
